title: Uniform and Atlas
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Lena Voss, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
